description: This source file is a Node.js script written in JavaScript, intended to analyze other source files to find calls to 'os.tmpdir()' or 'tmpdir()' functions, particularly to identify usage of temporary directory functions in messaging or channel runtime sources. It includes functions to parse TypeScript source files, extract import statements, identify specific function calls, and run as a script to perform such analysis.

methods.name: collectOsTmpdirImports
methods.description: Analyzes a TypeScript source file to collect import declarations related to 'os' module and identifies aliases for 'tmpdir' functions.

methods.name: findMessagingTmpdirCallLines
methods.description: Parses source content to locate lines where 'os.tmpdir()' or 'tmpdir()' functions are called, considering relevant imports.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function that executes the guard logic to find and report usage of 'os.tmpdir()' or 'tmpdir()' in messaging/channel sources.
